symbols.name: total edge rank
symbols.meaning: the sum of the ranks of a network's edges, a count of dimensions
symbols.quote: The strict total rank deficit is the inequality $s<Wm$, where $s$ is the sum of the edge ranks, $W$ is its number of wires and $m$ is the dimension of its label space.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: the number of wires of a network
symbols.quote: The strict total rank deficit is the inequality $s<Wm$, where $s$ is the sum of the edge ranks, $W$ is its number of wires and $m$ is the dimension of its label space.

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: the dimension of the label space
symbols.quote: The strict total rank deficit is the inequality $s<Wm$, where $s$ is the sum of the edge ranks, $W$ is its number of wires and $m$ is the dimension of its label space.

symbols.name: recursion levels
symbols.meaning: the number of levels of the recursion
symbols.quote: Recursing $k$ levels on size $n=m^k$ with $s/W$ smaller calls per wire costs $n^{\log_m(s/W)}$ per unit of data: a saving exactly when $s/W<m$.

symbols.name: problem size
symbols.meaning: the size $m^k$ of the recursive problem, a count of data units
symbols.quote: Recursing $k$ levels on size $n=m^k$ with $s/W$ smaller calls per wire costs $n^{\log_m(s/W)}$ per unit of data: a saving exactly when $s/W<m$.

symbols.quote: Write $W_{\rm b},s_{\rm b}$ and $W_{\rm c},s_{\rm c}$ for the wire counts and rank sums of the two networks.

symbols.name: bit rank sum
symbols.meaning: the sum of the edge ranks of the bit network
symbols.quote: Write $W_{\rm b},s_{\rm b}$ and $W_{\rm c},s_{\rm c}$ for the wire counts and rank sums of the two networks.

symbols.name: complex wire count
symbols.meaning: the number of wires of the complex network
symbols.quote: Write $W_{\rm b},s_{\rm b}$ and $W_{\rm c},s_{\rm c}$ for the wire counts and rank sums of the two networks.

symbols.name: complex rank sum
symbols.meaning: the sum of the residual dimensions of the complex network
symbols.quote: Write $W_{\rm b},s_{\rm b}$ and $W_{\rm c},s_{\rm c}$ for the wire counts and rank sums of the two networks.

symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: the number of elements in the ground set of triples, 100
symbols.quote: Here $h=100$ is the ground-set size, $v=\binom h3=161700$ the number of triples, and $N=v^3$ the number of input roles.

symbols.name: triple count
symbols.meaning: the number of three-element subsets of the ground set
symbols.quote: Here $h=100$ is the ground-set size, $v=\binom h3=161700$ the number of triples, and $N=v^3$ the number of input roles.

symbols.name: input role count
symbols.meaning: the number of input roles $X_a$, equal to $v^3$
symbols.quote: Here $h=100$ is the ground-set size, $v=\binom h3=161700$ the number of triples, and $N=v^3$ the number of input roles.

symbols.name: bit central wires
symbols.meaning: the number of central wires in each invocation of the bit network
symbols.quote: The $3v^2$ invocations each have $c_{\rm b}=100$ central wires, each losing $h$, so the total loss on decreasing edges is $L_{\rm b}=3v^2hc_{\rm b}$; likewise $L_{\rm c}=3v^2hc_{\rm c}$ with $c_{\rm c}=101$ central wires for the complex network.

symbols.name: complex dimension loss
symbols.meaning: the total dimension lost on decreasing edges of the complex network
symbols.quote: The $3v^2$ invocations each have $c_{\rm b}=100$ central wires, each losing $h$, so the total loss on decreasing edges is $L_{\rm b}=3v^2hc_{\rm b}$; likewise $L_{\rm c}=3v^2hc_{\rm c}$ with $c_{\rm c}=101$ central wires for the complex network.

symbols.name: vertex
symbols.meaning: a vertex of a network: a source, gate or sink
symbols.quote: Each vertex $p$ has a nondegenerate subspace $L_p$ (with $L_p\cap L_p^\perp=0$), and an edge $p\to q$ has matrix $M_q-M_p$, where $M_p=P_{L_p}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $L_p$.

symbols.name: head vertex
symbols.meaning: the vertex at the head of an edge from $p$
symbols.quote: Each vertex $p$ has a nondegenerate subspace $L_p$ (with $L_p\cap L_p^\perp=0$), and an edge $p\to q$ has matrix $M_q-M_p$, where $M_p=P_{L_p}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $L_p$.

symbols.name: vertex label
symbols.meaning: the nondegenerate subspace labelling vertex $p$
symbols.quote: Each vertex $p$ has a nondegenerate subspace $L_p$ (with $L_p\cap L_p^\perp=0$), and an edge $p\to q$ has matrix $M_q-M_p$, where $M_p=P_{L_p}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $L_p$.

symbols.name: vertex matrix
symbols.meaning: the orthogonal projection onto the label of vertex $p$, used on its edges
symbols.quote: Each vertex $p$ has a nondegenerate subspace $L_p$ (with $L_p\cap L_p^\perp=0$), and an edge $p\to q$ has matrix $M_q-M_p$, where $M_p=P_{L_p}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $L_p$.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: the orthogonal projection onto the label of vertex $p$
symbols.quote: Each vertex $p$ has a nondegenerate subspace $L_p$ (with $L_p\cap L_p^\perp=0$), and an edge $p\to q$ has matrix $M_q-M_p$, where $M_p=P_{L_p}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $L_p$.

symbols.name: nested label
symbols.meaning: a label contained in the label $V$
symbols.quote: For nested $U\subset V$, $P_V-P_U$ projects onto $V\cap U^\perp$, so the edge has rank $\dim V-\dim U$.

symbols.name: containing label
symbols.meaning: a label containing the label $U$
symbols.quote: For nested $U\subset V$, $P_V-P_U$ projects onto $V\cap U^\perp$, so the edge has rank $\dim V-\dim U$.

symbols.name: bit relative deficit
symbols.meaning: the relative rank deficit of the bit network
symbols.quote: Let $\eta_{\rm b}=(W_{\rm b}m-s_{\rm b})/(W_{\rm b}m)$ and $\eta_{\rm c}=(W_{\rm c}m-s_{\rm c})/(W_{\rm c}m)$ be the relative deficits, so $s/W=m(1-\eta)$.

symbols.name: complex relative deficit
symbols.meaning: the relative rank deficit of the complex network
symbols.quote: Let $\eta_{\rm b}=(W_{\rm b}m-s_{\rm b})/(W_{\rm b}m)$ and $\eta_{\rm c}=(W_{\rm c}m-s_{\rm c})/(W_{\rm c}m)$ be the relative deficits, so $s/W=m(1-\eta)$.

symbols.name: power exponent
symbols.meaning: the fixed exponent $1-2^{-50}$ below one

relations.quote: The rank count follows from [Nested subspace labels and orthogonal residuals](subspace-labels.md): adjacent labels are nested, and only central edges from time 3 to time 4 decrease.
The rank sum is counted over the edges of the [Three-stage bank exchange network](bank-exchange-network.md), which sends $(X_a,Y_a)$ to $(-Y_a,X_a)$.
